mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Federal Funds Rate over the next 20 trading days signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS does not decline over the 20-day window, the 20-day forward return is not significantly positive (p>0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rates above 0.3% over the next month signals labor market weakness, reducing corporate profits and investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE does not cross the 0.3% threshold within 3 months, the 20-day return is not significantly negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both GDP demand (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic growth, driving up equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 rises while INDPRO falls, or vice versa, the 20-day return is not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in RSAFS (demand in millions) over the next 60 days indicates robust consumer spending, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next quarter.
failure_condition: If RSAFS does not rise over the 60-day window, the 20-day forward return is not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 in the next 5 trading days signals supply-side weakness, reducing corporate profits and investor sentiment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next week.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 100 in the next 5 days
failure_condition: If INDPRO does not fall below 100 in the next 5 days, the 20-day return is not significantly negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDP demand (GDPC1) and employment (PAYEMS) signals robust economic expansion, driving up equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 rises while PAYEMS falls, or vice versa, the 20-day return is not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime, a decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 8.5% over the next 60 days signals improving labor market conditions, boosting corporate profits and equity returns, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next quarter.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 8.5% in the next 60 days
failure_condition: If UNRATE does not fall below 8.5% in the high-unemployment regime, the 20-day return is not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the next 60 days indicates strengthening supply chains and corporate activity, driving up S&P 500 forward returns over the next quarter.
failure_condition: If INDPRO does not rise over the 60-day window, the 20-day forward return is not significantly positive (p>0.05).
